# Therizinosaurus — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What does the name Therizinosaurus mean?", "scythe lizard"),
    ("What did Therizinosaurus eat?", "herbivore"),
    ("What is name meaning?", "scythe lizard"),
    ("What is period?", "Late Cretaceous"),
    ("What is lived (mya)?", "70"),
    ("What is length?", "10 m"),
    ("What is diet?", "herbivore"),
    ("What is found in?", "Mongolia"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
